analysis.file_name: Piper Sandler - NVIDIA Board Meets Uncertainty Remains Stock at Trough Multiple - 12 Nov 2026.pdf
analysis.title: NVIDIA Board Meets; Uncertainty Remains; Stock at Trough Multiple
key_insights: Multiple news reports say NVDA's board met late on 11/11 to decide the future of CEO and founder Jensen Huang. There was no official company announcement at the time of the note.

Piper thinks the board could appoint the CFO as interim CEO while it searches for a permanent one, because no definitive succession plan is in place. Piper sees Ian Buck, VP of Hyperscaler and HPC and a 22-year NVDA veteran, as a strong internal candidate.
Piper does not think a CEO change alters the investment case. It acknowledges higher risk but says the direction of travel is unchanged.

Piper says compute demand stays well ahead of supply this year and next. Product and roadmap decisions for the next 2 generations are already made, the architecture decisions cover roughly 3 years, and the company is sold out for CY27 and largely CY28. Customer discussions center on 2029 and beyond.
The area a new CEO could change is the extent of supply chain and ecosystem support and financing.
Piper expects revenue +70% y/y and EPS of about $15 in FY28 (the conclusion calls it CY27). It sees $150 as the floor at a 10x trough multiple, which it calls a 20-year low.
Piper expects the stock to stay under pressure in the short term until there is more visibility, and calls current levels a long-term buying opportunity.
The $300 price target uses 14x CY28E earnings of about $23. The stock was at $173.73.

market_movers.rationale: A CEO change does not alter the product roadmap or customer demand. The stock trades at a 10x trough multiple, with $150 seen as a floor.

earnings_insights: Piper expects FY28 revenue +70% y/y and EPS of about $15 (estimate). The note also states CY27 revenue +70% and $15 EPS.
The $300 price target is based on 14x CY28E EPS of about $23 (estimate).

trade_ideas.rationale: Fundamentals and the product roadmap are unchanged by a CEO change, and the stock trades at a 20-year trough multiple of 10x.
trade_ideas.risk: Competition, hyperscaler capex pullback, and circular financing concerns materializing.

tension_points.bull_case: A CEO change does not alter the investment case. The product roadmaps for the next 2 generations are set, the company is sold out for CY27 and largely CY28, and the stock trades at a 10x trough multiple with a $150 floor.
tension_points.bear_case: There is higher risk with no definitive succession plan. A new CEO could change the extent of supply chain and ecosystem support and financing, and the stock is likely to stay under pressure until there is visibility.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A new CEO changing the extent of supply chain and ecosystem support and financing.
